Dear Customer Support Team,

### Issue

The lamp has stopped powering on entirely. Despite multiple troubleshooting attempts, the unit remains completely unresponsive with no indicator lights or signs of power.

### Troubleshooting Steps Taken

1. Verified the power outlet is functional by testing with other devices.
2. Tried using different power cables and adapters.

As this product is within its warranty coverage period, I would like to request a repair, replacement, or other resolution as outlined in the warranty terms.

I have attached [photos of the issue / proof of purchase / any relevant documents] for your reference. Please let me know if any additional information is needed to process this claim.

Thank you for your time and assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
[Your Full Name]

[Your Mailing Address]
